trigger: The owner reported 60 FPS at the presenter and about 15 FPS at the observer while watching a screen share.
code_level_cause: The selected frameRate was passed only as a capture constraint. Pinned livekit-client 2.22.3 defaults screenShareEncoding to ScreenSharePresets.h1080fps15.encoding (15 FPS), and LocalParticipant merges publish defaults with the application's publish options. The application previously passed no screenShareEncoding override. Presenter diagnostics could also report source getSettings().frameRate as measured sender FPS when sender stats had no FPS.
change: All four selected screen profiles now pass matching capture frameRate and screenShareEncoding.maxFramerate. Encoding bitrate and medium priority reuse the pinned SDK h720fps30/h1080fps30 preset values, and voice-first maintain-framerate remains. Publisher diagnostics now show FPS only when sender stats provide it; capture settings can still supply dimensions.
